description:
Running `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features` fails. 11 unresolved intra-doc links across 6 crates:

| Crate | File:Line | Broken link |
|---|---|---|
| jmap-base-client (LOCKED) | crate-jmap-base-client/src/error.rs:70 | `[`WsSession::send_request`]` |
| jmap-base-client (LOCKED) | crate-jmap-base-client/src/error.rs:79 | `[`ClientConfig::max_sse_frame`]` |
| jmap-calendars-types | crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/notification.rs:137 | `[`Alert`]` |
| jmap-calendars-server | crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs:113,126,155,226 | `[`CalendarEvent`]` (x4) |
| jmap-calendars-server | crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/principal.rs:16 | `[`BusyPeriod`]` |
| jmap-tasks-server | crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/backend.rs:134 | `[`Task`]` |
| jmap-sharing-server | crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/backend.rs:43 | `[`Id`]` |
| jmap-chat-client | crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/quota.rs:17 | `[`SessionClient::quota_get`]` |

All are mechanical fixes: add a `use` import, fully qualify the path, or escape the brackets. Note: jmap-base-client is a LOCKED crate per AGENTS.md — its 2 fixes need explicit user approval before edit.
